slides.title: Steal this ==handover== checklist
slides.sub: 7 things to get in your name before the last invoice.

slides.title: The app works. Then nobody can find the ==AWS password.==
slides.sub: Handover gaps show up months later, and the client pays for them.

slides.title: Code in **your** GitHub
slides.body: The repo lives in your own GitHub or GitLab organisation. The team works in it as invited members.

slides.title: Accounts in **your** name
slides.body: Cloud, domain and App Store accounts are owned by you. Agency access is removed when you ask.

slides.title: A vault and a ==1-page runbook==
slides.body: Every credential in a shared password vault, not an email thread. One page on how to deploy, roll back and restart.

slides.title: Keys listed, architecture recorded
slides.body: Environment variables and third-party API keys documented, plus a recorded walkthrough of how the system fits together.

slides.title: What to build ==next==
slides.body: Known issues and the next sensible improvements, written down while the team still remembers them.

slides.title: Ask for this list on ==day one==
slides.body: A good outsourced development team won't mind.

slides.title: You need AI where a task ==repeats.==
Worth automating
items: Pulling totals out of PDF invoices

slides.title: A chatbot added because ~~the demo looked good~~
Which task does your team **repeat** every day?
Save this for your next ==roadmap meeting==
A developer in ==72 hours==
slides.sub: React, Node.js or Python. Tried for 7 days before you commit.

slides.title: Hiring shouldn't take longer than ==building the feature.==
Share the stack and the work
slides.body: Tell us what you're building, the tech stack and the hours you need each week.

slides.title: Meet vetted developers
slides.body: We introduce developers who have shipped similar work. You pick the one you want.

slides.title: to onboard
slides.body: Your developer joins your repo, your Slack and your standups.

slides.title: risk-free trial
slides.body: Judge real pull requests, not a CV. Not the right fit? Walk away.

slides.title: Comment ==HIRE==
slides.body: We'll message you the details. The NDA is signed before you share a single file.
